CAP. 255] Protection of New Plant Varieties
4
CHAPTER 255
105 of 2001. PROTECTION OF NEW PLANT VARIETIES ACT
Act 16 of 2001. (COMMENCEMENT) ORDER
(Section 54)
[28th July, 2001.]
Short title. 1. This Order may be cited as the
PROTECTION OF NEW PLANT VARIETIES ACT
(COMMENCEMENT) ORDER.
Commencement 2. In exercise of the powers conferred upon me by section 54 of the
of Chapter 255. Protection of New Plants Varieties Act and all other powers thereunto me
enabling, I, GODFREY SMITH, Attorney General, do hereby appoint the
9th day of July, 2001, as the day on which the said Act shall come into force.
MADE this 9th day of July, 2001.
(GODFREY SMITH)
Attorney General
